title: Measure 12 campaign spot
description: A political ad using clones of voices whose owners block political use.
transcript: Vote for change this November, together we can fix the roads and lower your taxes. Support Measure 12 and keep our schools funded for the next generation. My opponent has failed this district for 10 years, it's time for new leadership. Paid for by the committee to elect a better council, make your voice heard on election day.
